# SkellyCAD

CAD, eye-tracker hardware, camera electronics and learning projects.
Start with a project below; its README distinguishes selected assemblies,
review candidates and available print packages.

| Project | Start here |
| --- | --- |
| Eye trackers | [Mouse, rat, marmoset and human](designs/eye-tracker/README.md) |
| Camera modules | [Pupil reference and camera development](designs/cameras/README.md) |
| Capture enclosure | [Frame and capture studies](designs/enclosure/README.md) |
| Preserved Mouse Hats | [Historical designs and replay](designs/mouse-hats/README.md) |
| CAD Foundations | [FreeCAD lessons](designs/cad-foundations/README.md) |
| KiCad Foundations | [Electronics lessons](designs/kicad-foundations/README.md) |

[Working guide](docs/organization-guide.md) · [Setup and validation](docs/development.md) ·
[Version control](docs/version-control.md) · [Citations](CITATIONS.md)

The preferred Pupil geometry is the [complete R08 module](designs/cameras/pupil-core-eye/README.md).
Historical assemblies retain their pinned geometry and matched parts.

[Repository cleanup plan](docs/repository-organization.md) ·
[Cleanup and preservation record](docs/migration/repo-cleanup-2026-10-31/README.md) ·
[Original import record](docs/migration/README.md)

Local runtimes stay in `.cad-tools/`; working runs go to `generated/`.
The original `old-cad-playground/` remains untouched for the user's migration review.

designs/eye-tracker/README.md:
# Eye trackers

Choose an animal, then a hardware variant. Camera models are shared through the
[camera catalog](../cameras/README.md); mounting and targeting code lives in
[shared](shared/README.md).

| Animal | Current scope |
| --- | --- |
| [Mouse](mouse/README.md) | Monocular; selected complete R19 assembly, R23 anatomy/print derivative. |
| [Rat](rat/README.md) | Historical monocular selection, binocular R43 review, eye + world W06 review and corrected trial print package. |
| [Marmoset](marmoset/README.md) | Reference anatomy and skull print derivatives; no complete assembly selected. |
| [Human](human/README.md) | Placeholder; no assembly selected. |

A selected checkpoint, current candidate and print layout are separate records.
Geometry checks do not demonstrate physical fit. Read the variant README before
opening or exporting matched parts.

This is a historical camera direction. Current development is in
[OV9281](../ov9281/README.md). Earlier recommendations and concepts remain in
[the original overview](history/overview-before-cleanup.md),

designs/enclosure/README.md:
# Capture enclosure

The frame and optical layout studies are concepts, not a qualified capture system.
[History](history/README.md) contains the revision-first sequence.

- [R01 frame](history/r001-starter-cube/README.md): 500 mm clear starter enclosure.
- [R04 capture geometry](history/r004-capture-study/README.md): five-view floor-overlap study.
- [R05 lens study](history/r005-lens-study/README.md): reported manual-varifocal lens range.
- [R06 withdrawn hardware recommendation](history/r006-usb-baseline/README.md): rectangular sensors failed the square-active-array requirement; retained for comparison only.

No hardware configuration is selected as accepted. Use the existing study source
through the isolated replay workflow; create a maintained `src/` when a current
configuration is selected rather than promoting the withdrawn R06 by its number.
